PATIO DEL OLIVO

A kitchen with a neighbourhood soul

A welcoming table, recipes to share and room for a long conversation.

The pleasure of everyday food

In this fictional restaurant, we imagine a small team cooking Mediterranean recipes with care. The menu follows the season, and the dining room welcomes quick lunches and long afternoons alike.
